Run any coding agent on any host, and use it as if it ran here

## Synopsis

simstim runs coding agents in sessions on hosts you reach with SSH.
Sessions keep running when you leave. Run it with no arguments for the launcher.

```text
simstim [flags]
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for simstim
```
